text:
maria: quick heads-up — i'm starting a compact-role refactor on the console that collapses some legacy role rows. goal: simpler UI mapping and fewer edge-case permutations. planning PR for Wed. any blockers from audit/KMS side?

Tom: compact-role = how many roles are we collapsing? can you paste the mapping?

maria: short version: combine several narrow roles into feature flags and three primary roles (viewer/editor/admin). keep 'billing' and 'deploy' as scoped capability flags. snippet:```
# proposed mapping (simplified)
viewer -> [read:projects, read:metrics]
editor -> viewer + [write:projects, manage:models]
admin -> editor + [manage:org, manage:keys]
# capability flags: billing, deploy (opt-in)
```

kevin: two immediate concerns: 1) audit logging — compliance wants original role identifiers preserved (we can't rewrite logs to new names). 2) KMS access — admin becomes broader; need to ensure KMS key policies are principal-based not role-based. we had a shadow-bind bug last quarter where an import job accidentally granted editor perms.

angela: fwiw the UI gating code still checks by role slug (e.g., `role === "editor"`). if we start using feature flags + compact roles, we must change gating to check capability flags or permission predicates. otherwise we risk surface regressions.

maria: yep — plan is to switch gating to permission predicates first, then flip the user-facing mapping. that preserves behaviour. but that touches many guardrails.

sec-bot: alert: created incident-keys-2026-07 — shadow-bind detected in import job 'org-backfill-2026-06'. Related artifacts: https://ci.internal/1234, logs attached.

kevin: timeline: i can add an audit shim that records pre-refactor role aliases in a separate audit field before we change the DB canonical role column. that keeps historical semantics for reviewers. will need ~1 day.

Tom: reproduction steps for the shadow-bind bug (from last run) — keeping here so we avoid it:
1) run POST /api/orgs/:id/import with roles in legacy csv
2) importer merges by email, applies role slug from csv if present
3) importer doesn't validate against existing org-level scoped constraints and writes `role_slug` directly
4) UI later interprets new slug -> elevated access

angela: propose we add a server-side validation `authorize_import_role` that checks: role_slug in allowed_set_for_org && no implicit binds. block and log otherwise.

maria: agree. also KMS question: when admin gains `manage:keys`, do we map that to the console admin or to key principals? kevin?

kevin: must be mapped to principals. KMS best practice: grant kms:Encrypt/Decrypt to service accounts or principals, not roles that can be swapped. for console UI actions that trigger key operations, use short-lived service creds tied to the user via OIDC + aud claim and log that exchange in audit.

maria: ok. i'll update the RFC to say: (a) add audit_alias field that stores original role slug on import, (b) change gating to permission predicates, (c) add importer validation and block shadow binds, (d) ensure KMS access is principal-bound and add log for key ops.

Tom: can we get a quick smoke-test matrix? i'm happy to run it. suggested tests: create user with legacy 'project-contrib' csv role -> import -> UI should show viewer capabilities only; audit record must contain `audit_alias: project-contrib`; KMS ops should fail for non-admin.

angela: i'll add unit tests for gating predicates and a small e2e to the console repo.

kevin: i'll draft the KMS principal mapping doc and sample policy before the PR. note: we should also run a query for existing `role_slug` values and flag any that are ambiguous to the new compact mapping.

maria: next steps: i'll open the RFC PR now, link to this thread. owners: maria (design+PR), kevin (KMS + audit shim), angela (UI gating + tests), tom (e2e & smoke). target merge: Wed EOD. if anyone can't, call it out now. :thumbsup:

Tom: +1, available.

kevin: +1, will start KMS doc today.

angela: +1, will queue gating changes.

maria: thanks — ping me for any infra creds you need. i'll include a rollback plan in the PR (feature flag + DB `audit_alias` fallback).
